title: Trump administration is paying $1.6 million a week to keep Voice of America staff on leave - The Washington Post
description: Hundreds of VOA staffers have been on paid leave since the agency sidelined them in March 2025.

title: Tony Romo, CBS Sports agree to part after ex-QB's DWI arrest - ESPN
description: Tony Romo will not return as an NFL game analyst for CBS Sports, the network announced, after he was arrested in July on charges of operating a vehicle while intoxicated.

title: U.S. economy added 29,000 jobs in September, signaling a slower labor market - The Washington Post
description: Forecasters had expected gains of about 84,000 new jobs in September, consistent with a stable but sluggish labor market.

title: After another early exit, Caitlin Clark’s career is still lacking playoff success - NBC News

title: G7 countries to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil reserves - NBC News
description: Group of Seven countries agreed to release tens of millions of barrels of diesel fuel and crude to cap soaring gas prices.
